item.title: Describe Your Room
item.prompt_text: Describe your bedroom. Say if it is big or small, what furniture is in it, what colours you can see, and what you do there.
item.target_grammar: there is / there are; present simple
item.fluency_objective: Join short sentences with 'and' and 'but' instead of stopping after every one.
item.pronunciation_objective: Say 'there is' and 'there are' smoothly, linking the words together.
item.model_answer: My room is small, but I like it. There is a bed, a desk and a chair. There is a big window next to the desk, so my room is very light. The walls are white and the curtains are blue. I study at my desk every evening, and I read books in bed. At the weekend, I listen to music and relax in my room.
item.model_opening: My room is small, but I like it.
